subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue official iOS CarPlay support now, and if so which Apple CarPlay category, entitlement path, and constrained Talk UX should the app target?
rationale: This is a new official app and release-signing surface, not a broken existing contract; automation cannot choose the Apple category, entitlement strategy, or driving-safety product model.

options.title: Keep And Scope CarPlay
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Mobile Design RFC
options.body: Evaluate CarPlay through the broader mobile design direction before accepting a platform-specific implementation issue.

options.title: Decline For Now
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide CarPlay entitlement, review, or safety constraints make this out of scope for the official app in the near term.

recommendation.title: Keep And Scope CarPlay
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They were explicitly tagged in the issue discussion and have recent merged iOS Talk work that the requested voice-first CarPlay flow would likely reuse.
